mapper.update: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS idempotency_record ( id BIGINT AUTO_INCREMENT PRIMARY KEY, owner_id VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, operation VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, idempotency_key VARCHAR(128) NOT NULL, request_fingerprint CHAR(64) NOT NULL, status VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL, response_payload LONGTEXT, error_message VARCHAR(512), created_at DATETIME NOT NULL, updated_at DATETIME NOT NULL, expire_at DATETIME NOT NULL, UNIQUE KEY uk_idempotency_owner_operation_key (owner_id, operation, idempotency_key), KEY idx_idempotency_record_expire_at (expire_at), KEY idx_idempotency_record_owner_created_at (owner_id, created_at) ) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4
